versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Australian Business Verification skill.
- Verifies Australian businesses via official ABR JSON API using ABN, ACN, or entity name.
- Returns registration status, entity type, GST registration status, business location, and trading names.
- Designed for use in KYC, supplier onboarding, invoice checks, compliance, and due-diligence workflows.
- Requires a free ABR GUID for authentication; setup instructions included.
